monument_name: Ī Bahī Vãtā Vihāra (ca. 17th cent. CE)
description_en: Ī Bahī Vãtā Vihāra, also named Syõ Bahī ("ruined monastery"), is located to the north of Yampi Mahāvihāra in front of the northern Aśoka Stūpa. The courtyard with three shrines and threecaityasis supposed to be a branch of the Yampi Mahāvihāra.The Bahī area measures 21m x 30 m. The sunken courtyard is 82 cm below floor level, paved with flagstone tiles and measuring 10 m x 24 m. It is also home to threecaityas. The southernmost Caitya is avajradhātucaitya, while two other areśikharakūṭacaityas.To the east of the sunken courtyard, one can find three roofed shrines for the deities each Caitya facing west. The three structures are similar and measure 3.3 x 3.8 m. Local inhabitants worship these three small shrines as three differentvihāras. Inside the shrines are three newly made stone images of Akṣobhya Buddha.Pruscha(1975, 209) andLocke(1985, 205)  wrote about this monument, and it seems that some remnants of thevihārawere still present at their time. However, there are some contradictions in their descriptions. Pruscha writes that bronze images of Dīpaṅkara were enshrined in the temple sanctum dated 1672 CE (NS 792). Locke states that "the northernmost shrine contains an image of Akṣobhya flanked by an image of Praj̃nāpāramitā on his right and one of Avalokiteśvara on his left; the central shrine has an image of Akṣobhya flanked by Padmapāṇi Lokeśvara on his right and Prajñāpāramitā on his left. The southern shrine has a headless image of Akṣobhya”.
description_ne: यम्पि महाविहारसँग जोडिएको उत्तरतर्फको यो विहार पनि यम्पि महाविहारको शाखा विहार हो । नेवारीमा यंताको अर्थ उत्तर हो । कुनै पनि विहारमा हुनुपर्ने विशेषता यो विहारमा पाइँदैन । यो बही पूर्ण रूपले भत्की घाँसे चौरमा परिणत भैसकेको थियो । पूर्ण रूपले बिग्रिसकेकोले स्थानीयहरू यसलाई स्यंबही (Ruined Monastery) भन्ने गर्छन् ।विहारको मूलद्वार लगायत अगाडिको भागमा फलामको रेलिंग लगाइएको छ । चौरमा ढुंगा छापेर विहार परिसर खुल्ला छोडिएको छ । यहाँ द्य:छेँ भनेर तीनवटा स-साना मन्दिर बनाइएका छन् । स्थानीयहरू यी तीनवटा मन्दिरलाई तीन अलग-अलग विहार मानी पूजा गर्छन् । प्रुस्चा र लकले अध्ययन गर्दा पुरानो विहारका अवशेष बाँकी थिए ।
